name: balanced-current-stable-3provider-v0.1
selection_rule: One current general-purpose production model from each of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, prioritizing broad availability, structured-output support, and tractable repeated-evaluation cost. Models are not assumed to be capability-equivalent.
sampling_policy: Provider-default sampling parameters; three replicates quantify residual stochasticity.

models.model_id_note: Use gpt-5.6-sol exactly as documented by OpenAI.

models.sampling_parameters: provider defaults; do not set non-default temperature/top_p/top_k
models.model_id_note: Canonical dateless Claude 5 model ID; Anthropic documents post-4.6 dateless IDs as pinned snapshots.
